title: SaneLinkRules
description: Rules definition schema for SaneLink open-source sanitization rules

universalParameters.description: Query parameters stripped from any URL regardless of domain

name.description: Human readable name of the service

description.description: Short explanation of what is cleaned

domains.description: List of domains matching this rule (without protocol)

stripParameters.description: Query parameters to strip for these domains

keepParameters.description: Explicit parameters to preserve if whitelist strategy is desired

paths.description: Specific URL paths to match (e.g. /url or /l.php)

unwrapParameter.description: Query parameter containing the encoded real destination URL

canonicalPathRegex.description: Regex applied to the URL path to normalize it (e.g. Amazon /dp/ASIN)

canonicalPathReplacement.description: Replacement string with $1, $2 capture groups for path regex

rewriteDomain.description: Alternative privacy frontend host (e.g. fxtwitter.com, redlib.catsarch.com)
